card.name: First digit of a multi-digit number
card.fires_on: The leading digit, usually 1 or 2, that starts a multi-digit number such as a year, a count, a percentage or a dose. It appears right after a comma, a space or a word like 'from' or 'than'.

modes.label: Start of a year
modes.description: The digit 1 or 2 that begins a four-digit year, often in a date range or reference list.

modes.label: Start of a count or dose
modes.description: The first digit of a number of subjects, a percentage or a milligram amount.
